content:
In recent years, Macs have become increasingly good value. The starting price is lower, you get more memory and storage for your money, and the MacBook Neo has also been launched. For the first time, Apple has become one of the best-value choices on the market.

Unfortunately, due to the ongoing memory shortage, Apple raised prices significantly a few days ago. Macs are no longer as attractive as they were a few weeks ago, but there are still some good deals out there—if you need a new computer, I would still say that the current Mac lineup remains excellent value across the entire PC market.

MacBook Air

Before the MacBook Neo was launched, the MacBook Air was the entry-level model in Apple's laptop lineup. Although the MacBook Neo has made its value proposition a little awkward, if you want a better user experience and don't need any high-end features, I would still say the MacBook Air is a fantastic laptop.

MagSafe, a P3 wide colour gamut display, Center Stage for the webcam, and longer battery life are just some of the highlights of the MacBook Air. It also comes in a 15-inch version, unlike the MacBook Neo which is only available in 13 inches.

MacBook Neo

This product hardly needs an introduction—the MacBook Neo is Apple's first affordable MacBook, priced at just $699.

Compared with the MacBook Air mentioned above, there are some compromises, but for the price, it's an incredible deal. Build quality, display clarity, and the macOS experience are essentially uncompromised. Yes, you have to accept a slightly slower A18 Pro chip (but honestly, it's by no means bad), fewer ports, and only 8GB of memory, but at this price, that's entirely reasonable. It also comes in fun colour options like Citrus, Blush, and Indigo.

The MacBook Neo doesn't have any major retailer discounts at the moment, but Apple does offer refurbished models, which are $100 to $120 cheaper than the new price. Apple Certified Refurbished products come with the same one-year warranty, are in like-new condition, and have every major component replaced. There will be no cosmetic damage or battery degradation issues.

  • MacBook Neo: 256GB storage, 8GB memory – $689 at Amazon ($10 off)
  • MacBook Neo: 512GB storage, 8GB memory, Touch ID – $789 at Amazon ($10 off)
  • Refurbished MacBook Neo: 256GB storage, 8GB memory – $599 at Apple Store
  • Refurbished MacBook Neo: 512GB storage, 8GB memory, Touch ID – $679 at Apple Store

MacBook Pro

The MacBook Pro is the flagship of the entire lineup. You get the best of everything, but there's one important thing to note. Reports suggest that Apple will redesign the high-end MacBook Pro later this year, adding OLED, a touchscreen, and a thinner design.

However, that refresh will debut only on models equipped with the M5 Pro and M5 Max chips—so if you're buying the base model with the M5 chip, there's no problem at all buying a new Mac today. If you don't care about the refresh at all, that's fine too, because the M5 Pro and M5 Max are themselves extremely powerful new chips.
